value_assessment.benefit: Close verified workspace escape, revoked delivery, stuck retry, hidden CI failure, repeated Issue history, biased paired order, local route mismatch, and unbounded monitoring findings.
scope: Default-deny Codex filesystem reads with one-file review output exception
Recheck delivery authorization before remote writes and make explicit reapproval retryable
Align built-in local model execution, readiness, probing, and accounting
Show failed CI in project-scoped attention views and recover after reruns
Use durable server-side Issue update filtering with overlap and held revisions
Balance and persist strategy trial order
Schedule post-merge checks by due time and stop after retention
Protect main with required PR, current-base CI, and conversation resolution

evidence: 149 Python unittest cases passed on macOS with Python 3.9.6.
25 frontend request tests, JavaScript syntax checks, and Chromium workbench checks passed.

The installed Codex sandbox denied unregistered files, registered project files, and controller state; network and project writes were denied for review roles, while one structured result file remained writable.
No paid model calls, real GitHub writes to target projects, or real provider compatibility claims were used for regression tests.
Plugin ZIP with checksum and wheel built for 0.2.2.

automated_review_findings.finding: A closed or newly excluded Issue revision could be removed from the pending cursor while its task was still active, then disappear after the update watermark advanced.
automated_review_findings.resolution: Retain the bounded revision snapshot while the task is active or still awaiting a delivery decision; obsolete it when synchronization reaches a state that can safely stop the task. Added a restart-safe regression test.

residual_limits: This is author self-review plus an automated Codex Review; no independent human review was available. The repository has one maintainer and does not require a second approval.
A remote request already issued cannot be recalled by a later pause or cancellation.
Live provider behavior, long-term monitoring, and real-model capability changes were not tested.
